ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the left side of the figure is labeled “sea,” indicating the ocean; the figure has annual isohyets, with the unit being mm. Higher precipitation lines such as 1000 mm and 750 mm are mainly distributed on the left-side nearshore and coastal mountain area, while contour lines such as 500 mm and 250 mm appear successively toward the inland direction on the right, indicating that precipitation overall decreases from the coast toward the inland. Judging by the conventional orientation on the map, north is up and south is down, west is left and east is right. Reasoning: high-precipitation areas are usually the windward side where moist airflows first arrive and form more precipitation, while low-precipitation areas are the leeward side or the drier inland side. Therefore, the moist airflow that brings precipitation to this region in winter should blow from the high-precipitation area of the ocean on the left toward the low-precipitation inland area on the right; combined with the directional relationship in the figure, it can be judged that the airflow mainly comes from the southwest direction.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the map of annual isohyets in a certain local region (the figure below, unit: mm).

<image1>

According to the information shown in the figure, what wind mainly prevails in this region in winter?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有海洋在左侧，年降水量高值1000 mm、750 mm集中在近海或沿海山地一带，500 mm、250 mm等值线向右侧内陆递减。再读题干：要求根据年等降水量线判断该区域冬季主要盛行风。推理时把降水高值区视作湿润气流首先到达的迎风侧，把低值区视作背风或内陆干燥侧；湿润冬季气流应从海洋高降水侧吹向内陆低降水侧。按图上方为北、左为西的方向关系，气流来自西南方向，因此答案为西南风。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧标注“海”，表示海洋；图中有年等降水量线，单位为 mm。1000 mm、750 mm等较高降水量线主要分布在左侧近海和沿海山地一带，500 mm、250 mm等值线向右侧内陆方向依次出现，说明降水总体由沿海向内陆递减。图上按常规方向判读，上北下南、左西右东。推理：降水高值区通常是湿润气流首先到达并形成较多降水的迎风侧，降水低值区则是背风侧或更干燥的内陆侧。因此该区域冬季带来降水的湿润气流应从左侧海洋的高降水区吹向右侧内陆的低降水区；结合图中方向关系，可判断气流主要来自西南方向。
